teamDetailedDescription: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh. My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention. Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research. My research experience and focus areas include: Clinical Surveillance & Antimicrobial Stewardship, Nanomedicine & Computational Biology, Epidemiology & Parasitology, Water Quality & Livestock Health, Socio-Veterinary Studies, Wildlife Rescue & Clinical Service. I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in the veterinary, nanomedicine, and public health sectors to continue learning and contributing to innovative, evidence-based solutions in disease prevention.
